clauses.title: The autofix driver relaunches only its own codes, before any counter moves
A failed gate that left no designated output reads as absent output
The record states the one relaunch
requires: may be relaunched exactly once per run as `gate_transport@gate_launch`, consuming no counter
however malformed, keeps the failure terminal
after any mutation, Luna task, or reply the key is terminal exactly as before

clauses.title: Relaunch fixtures pin the row, the carve-out, and the record
requires: the driver relaunches a zero-output gate once, and the record states the line and its divergence
the stop rule names both exceptions
CL-D51 records the widening under CL-D39
